metadata.description: Nome do workspace de Log Analytics do laboratório.

properties.description:
Esta consulta identifica duas entradas bem-sucedidas da mesma conta,
em locais diferentes, com intervalo curto demais para um deslocamento
físico. O sinal usa o campo Location já presente no log de entrada.
properties.query:
let maxMinutes = 120;
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == "0"
| where isnotempty(UserPrincipalName) and isnotempty(Location) and isnotempty(IPAddress)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Location, AppDisplayName
| sort by UserPrincipalName asc, TimeGenerated asc
| serialize
| extend
    PrevUser = prev(UserPrincipalName),
    PrevLocation = prev(Location),
    PrevIP = prev(IPAddress),
    PrevTime = prev(TimeGenerated)
| where UserPrincipalName == PrevUser and Location != PrevLocation
| extend MinutesBetween = datetime_diff("minute", TimeGenerated, PrevTime)
| where MinutesBetween between (0 .. maxMinutes)
| extend
    Name = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "@")[1]),
    MinutesBetweenText = tostring(MinutesBetween),
    StartTime = PrevTime,
    EndTime = TimeGenerated
| project
    StartTime,
    EndTime,
    UserPrincipalName,
    Name,
    UPNSuffix,
    IPAddress,
    PrevIP,
    Location,
    PrevLocation,
    MinutesBetweenText,
    AppDisplayName

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Entradas em {{PrevLocation}} e {{Location}} no intervalo da regra.
